incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired - HIGH - inference-eu-gpupool - thermal-throttle - 2876543211
pagerbot: @devon @maria page fired: inference-eu-gpupool elevated 5xx & latency > 2s :rotating_light:
devon: taking this, acked in PD
maria: thanks. are customers impacted?
devon: initial metric shows ~15% errors for embeddings requests to eu region, spikes started ~3m ago
alex: i'm on standby to help failover.
devon: Plan: mark pool as draining, route traffic to dedicated-fallback-01, increase capacity if needed. executing now.
jules: ping on config to force fallback? any short command?
devon: running: `redwoodctl pool drain inference-eu-gpupool --reason "thermal throttle"`
devon: also triggering route override: `redwoodctl route set --model default --target dedicated-fallback-01 --weight 1.0`
incident-bot: action logged: pool drain started by devon
maria: any customer-facing tickets? I can draft a status note if impact persists.
devon: so far auto-fallback took ~40% traffic, errors dropping to ~6%
alex: spinning up one more fallback instance, ETA ~90s
devon: error rate now 1.8%, latency down to baseline. keeping page open until drain completes.
jules: recommend followup: create post-incident ticket to investigate cooling and autoscale policy
maria: will open a PSR and notify CS. tagging @pagerbot for customer notifications
pagerbot: Scheduled customer update queued to send every 15m until resolved
devon: I'll hand off after drain completes. current owner: devon -> ping me for final status
alex: noted, standing by for rollback if needed
devon: drain finished, pool removed from rotation. closing PD page, will write recap in incidents channel.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved - inference-eu-gpupool - resolved by devon - 2876543580 :white_check_mark:
